test_title: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 23 Jun, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: In March 2025, the Indian government passed the Waqf (Amendment) Act, leading to nationwide protests. Which organisation led the protests, calling the bill "unconstitutional and undemocratic"?

options.text: All India Shia Personal Law Board
All India Muslim Personal Law Board

solution:
The Correct answer is __**All India Muslim Personal Law Board**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **All India Muslim Personal Law Board (AIMPLB)** was established in **1973**.
 
• It is a **non-governmental organization** that aims to protect and promote the application of Islamic personal laws (Shariat) for Muslims in India.
 
• The organization played a pivotal role in the protests against the **Waqf (Amendment) Act** of 2025, terming it as "unconstitutional and undemoc
